material.description: Fact: panCamera (js/client/render3d.js:210-218) scales every axis by k (render3d.js:211) and adds the forward vector times dyPx*k (render3d.js:215). The ground is seen foreshortened by sin(pitch), so 1 px of vertical drag moves the ground under the pointer by sin(pitch) px, not 1 px. Live evaluation of render3d.js (createCamera, panCamera, viewProjection, 1 px vertical drag, distance 30): 0.296 px at pitch 0.3, 0.784 px at pitch 0.9, 0.933 px at pitch 1.2. Horizontal drag tracks 1:1. Callers: js/client/play.js:1228 (renderer3d.pan on pointer drag), js/client/play.js:1097 (keyboard pan, vertical axis), js/client/editor.js:301 (middle or shift drag), render3d.js:556 (pan method). The comment at render3d.js:208-209 claims the scale is world units per pixel at the target; that holds only on the horizontal axis. Distinct from the devicePixelRatio scale in milner-trav-minimap-camera-1. Witness: codesearch dispatch 1792858394248-4308-646edc8c279bb72a (panCamera callers); no test under js/ references panCamera.

notes.note: Triage keep. Located: render3d.js:210-218 panCamera scales both axes by k (:211) and moves along the horizontal forward vector (:215); the comment at :208-209 says world units per pixel. A vertical pixel moves the ground under the pointer by sin(pitch) px, because the ground foreshortens. Observable: vertical drag (play.js:1228) and W/S keys (play.js:1097) lag the pointer at low pitch, about 30% at pitch 0.3. Reads: render3d.js 1-230 dispatch 1792859429069-6387-bfc94482968edb06; play.js 1095-1105 dispatch 1792859546359-6440-94a9f3ded5dfe3e5.
